entries.title: Critical bond percolation on Z^d: 2026 formal claim
entries.statement: For nearest-neighbour independent Bernoulli bond percolation on Z^d, define theta_d(p)=P_p(the open cluster of the origin is infinite) and p_c(d)=inf{p in [0,1]:theta_d(p)>0}. The pinned 2026 Anthropic formal artifact reports a comparator-checked proof of theta_d(p_c(d))=0 for every integer d>=2, covering the historical open cases 3<=d<=10. This entry records the reported formal claim and its exact target; independent rebuild and statement-fidelity review remain pending in w425's referee packet.
assumptions: reported formal proof not independently rebuilt by w425

source.excerpt: The formal statement is the vanishing at p_c

entries.title: Finite-graph additive gluing in the formal percolation route
entries.statement: For independent bond retention with arbitrary weights in [0,1] on a finite graph, the pinned 2026 formal artifact reports the additive gluing inequality: if P(a connected to b)>=1-t for every a in a fixed relay set A, then P(o connected to b)>=P(o connected to A)-t. The artifact uses this inequality to establish Kozma--Nitzan Conjecture 3 and then critical nonpercolation on Z^d. The proof was not independently rebuilt by w425; this is a source-status concept rather than a promoted theorem.
assumptions: independent weighted Bernoulli bonds with weights in [0,1]
fixed vertices o,b and deterministic relay set A
reported formal proof not independently rebuilt by w425

relations.rationale: The pinned README proof outline explicitly routes additive gluing through Kozma--Nitzan Conjecture 3 and its Theorem 6 to theta(p_c)=0; both endpoint concepts quote that same pinned source.

The existing C0023 card, confirmed by w424's read-only CARD_EVIDENCE.json, retains its dated 2026-09-07 open-status text. This concept records the later pinned formal claim without treating that claim as independently audited.
